policy.qrCompatibility: All listed coreCodes remain permanently decodable; identity grouping never reassigns a QR index.
policy.uiBehavior: Consumers may deduplicate selection/search results by canonicalIdentityId while retaining the original coreCode on decoded historical records.
policy.mergeThreshold: Groups require exact/near-exact identity plus producer, industry, government or independently corroborated supply-chain evidence.

groups.evidence: Takesi's own site identifies the operation as its coffee finca in Sud Yungas/Yanacachi, La Paz; both v6 rows use the same farm name and country.
BSCA identifies Fazenda Rainha in São Sebastião da Grama as a single specialty-coffee property and competition producer; the v6 pair is an exact same-country English-name duplicate.
The producer's own site presents Café Granja La Esperanza and its farms/lots as one Colombian specialty-coffee operation; the two v6 rows share the same identity name.
The producer's own green-coffee site identifies La Palma & El Tucán as the Zipacón, Colombia estate/project; both v6 entries are the same-name same-country identity.
Café UBA identifies Finca Milán in Betulia/Arabia, Pereira as a single farm producing coffee since 1982; independent supply-chain listings describe the same producer/farm identity.

groups.canonicalNameZh: Java Frinsa Estate / 弗林莎庄园
groups.evidence: Java Frinsa Estate's own site identifies the West Java farm/processing operation owned by Wildan Mustofa and Atieq Mustikaningtyas; both v6 rows are the same Frinsa Estate identity.
Finca Deborah's official site and the Specialty Coffee Association of Panama identify one Volcán, Chiriquí farm operated by Jamison Savage.
Lamastus Family Estates' official site identifies Elida Estate as one of its Panama estates; both v6 rows are the same exact English estate name.

groups.canonicalNameZh: Hacienda La Esmeralda / 翡翠庄园
groups.evidence: Hacienda La Esmeralda's official site identifies a single Peterson-family specialty-coffee producer with multiple farms; the two v6 rows have identical English and Chinese identity names.
The Specialty Coffee Association of Panama and Finca Lérida's own estate/hotel site identify the same historic Boquete coffee estate.
Panama's government operation registry records FINCA HARTMANN S.A. in Santa Clara, Renacimiento, Chiriquí; the two v6 rows are identical farm-name entries in Panama.
Finca Tasta's official site identifies one Peruvian specialty-coffee farm/brand; the v6 pair is an exact same-country English-name duplicate.
